claims.claim: HDR uses a coarse-to-fine hierarchical latent tree before streaming output
Layer-wise flow matching is defined over all levels and tokens
Default entropy-matched schedule is [5,8,13,20,32,50] with Kmax=50 and beta=0.66
SHAP attends to same-level predecessor, parent/neighbouring parent tokens, and first-frame condition
Overall Success improves 34.22 to 60.29 and Avg. Progress 76.00 to 89.56 versus CausalForcing
Steady streaming latency is 0.70s after KV-cache initialization
HDR retains 82.9% of full-data success with 2% data
Robot maze uses 3000 virtual videos and 50 real videos plus IDM
HDR-WAM reaches RoboDojo Overall 5.47 / 3.00% without pretraining
Entropy-matched Table 5 overall is 60.29 / 89.56; All-50 is 58.38 / 88.21
Temporal attention is O(KN^2) for bidirectional and streaming AR, O(Kavg N) for HDR
HDR prefill is 16.19s versus 1.48s bidirectional and 2.44s CausalForcing
